_comment: signal_modulation/design01d_strips — SPATIAL channels on the design01 Nd:YAG amplifier: two 1 um Ey strips at y = +1.25 and y = -1.25 on guide_1's entrance, same wavelength 1.064, same polarisation — position is the ONLY thing distinguishing them (user, 2026-09-02: encode in the spatial dimension). Everything else (geometry, pump, SGMA) unchanged from design01. PHYSICS UNDER TEST: the inversion is local — gain at r depends on total intensity AT r — so spatial channels mix only where their fields overlap in the gain volume. Parallel non-overlapping beams are two separable pipes, f1(E1)+f2(E2), no cross terms. The question this design measures is how much overlap DIFFRACTION alone buys: a 1 um strip at 1.064 um in n=1.82 diffracts strongly, and the 5 um guide is multimode, so the strips spread and beat as they propagate. CROSS from the 64-pair sweep (tones 3,5, one per strip) then quantifies diffraction-only spatial mixing, to be compared against the polarisation channels' CROSS ~ 3.8e-4 (design01c, where overlap was total). field_map: full-cell 2Ddft at 1.064 for the single-strip spread visual (source_2 amplitude defaults to 0 so a plain `run.py` shows ONE strip propagating; the sweep generator overrides both amplitudes per run and is unaffected). NOTE the monitor spans the whole cell INCLUDING the source plane — the source point dominates raw colour scales (known SimpleSim gotcha), so plots must clip/percentile the scale, not trust vmax. run_until 3000 / dft 2000-3000, matching design01c so CROSS is directly comparable (the one-strip spread visual was taken at 2000/1000-2000 before this change; the field_map monitor stays in for the sweep — ~7 MB scratch per run, overwritten). Created 2026-09-02 from design01c_sweep64.

crystal._comment: the Nd:YAG block. sted = the same 4-level Maxwell-Bloch machinery as the dyes, with Nd:YAG's lines: lbdA 0.808, lbdE 1.064, REAL linewidths. SGMA x N is the scaled doping (see top comment).

sted._comment: 4-level Nd:YAG starting FULLY INVERTED (N3_0=30, N1_0=0): the 230 us upper-level lifetime means a pre-pumped crystal simply IS in this state when a ps-scale signal arrives. SGMA 1.86e-5 = x30 the literal 1 at.% Nd:YAG value (6.2e-7), giving gL ~= 2.3 over the 20 um block — visible gain without free-running. CORRECTED 2026-09-01: the first pilot shipped SGMA 2e-3, which is gL ~= 249; the crystal dumped 97% of its inversion within 1000 t.u. REGARDLESS of drive (identical at amp 1 and amp 100) and amp 100 went non-finite at t=2281. That is parasitic free-running, not modulation. Calibration used: alpha ~ 1.1*(SGMA*N) /um at gamma=0.1, with the Lorentzian PEAK scaling as 1/gamma — the 1/gamma factor is what makes a narrow crystal line so much more sensitive to SGMA than our broad dyes (190x here).

source_1._comment: strip channel 0: CW Ey at 1.064, 1 um wide, centred at y = +1.25 on guide_1's entrance. Default amplitude 40 so a plain run shows this strip alone (source_2 defaults to 0).

source_pump._comment: 808 nm CW pump entering the crystal FROM ABOVE: y-normal sheet on the crystal's top edge radiating down (SimpleSim free source placement, 2026-09-01). Ez, orthogonal to the Ey signal, so they never interfere directly; the crystal is isotropic so the pump still drives 1->4.

snap_point._comment: exit time trace, dt 0.2. Cheap at 3000 t.u. (5000 samples) and kept as the settling check: if the envelope has not flattened by dft_t_start the run is being read during the transient and every sweep point is contaminated.

pop_monitor._comment: Level populations N_l(t) AVERAGED over the crystal — the modulator's own state variable, and the cleanest read of when emission balances refill (N3 flattens). NOTE: no snap_interval on purpose. With snap_interval > 0 this sensor also stores the whole-cell snap_N (n_snaps, n_levels, Nx, Ny) + snap_E, which at 6000 t.u. is GBs per task; without it save() writes only {t, N}, the summed per-level series (sensor.py:305).

source_2._comment: strip channel 1: identical Ey strip at y = -1.25. Amplitude 0 by default (single-strip visual); the sweep generator drives it with cos(5t).

field_map._comment: full-cell steady-state field map at 1.064 — the spread visual. Covers guides + crystal + PML margins; clip the colour scale in plots.
